title: 切內里基線隧道
summary: 切內里是瑞士新阿爾卑斯鐵路線的南段關鍵，官方資料列長15.4公里並於2020年底全面營運。本課由縱坡與列車需求出發，連接施工物流、軌道基準、隧道氣動和設備交付；學員須解釋土建完成之後仍有哪些測試才能支持完整鐵路服務。
summaryEn: Ceneri is a southern link of the Swiss new transalpine railway, officially described as 15.4 km and fully operational at the end of 2020. Starting with gradient and train demand, this course connects construction logistics, track reference systems, tunnel aerodynamics and equipment handover to the evidence needed beyond civil completion.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「基線縱坡與牽引需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Base-alignment grade and traction demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響切內里基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ceneri Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「切內里基線隧道」的「服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「隧道模型掘進交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths” in “Ceneri Base Tunnel”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tunnel model drive handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.96 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.96 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.96 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.96 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力功率」如何影響切內里基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade-resistance power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ceneri Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grade-resistance power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grade-resistance power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求
knowledge.text: 以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。
knowledge.textEn: Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" is correct?
options: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。
optionsEn: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses.
quiz.explanation: 以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grade-resistance power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1436.5 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1436.5 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1436.5 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1436.5 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基線縱坡與牽引需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base-alignment grade and traction demand", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade-resistance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
knowledge.textEn: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base-alignment grade and traction demand"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grade-resistance power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。
knowledge.textEn: Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基線縱坡與牽引需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations.
quiz.explanation: 以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
